# codigate_app (Resource)

An app: a hostname Codigate serves through an agent, with who may reach it. Import by id (app_...) or by hostname.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Both apps live under example.com, a verified codigate_domain. Bypass paths and
# public access need such a domain (and a paid plan); the workspace app domain
# does not count.
resource "codigate_app" "wiki" {
  name                 = "Wiki"
  hostname             = "wiki.example.com"
  agent_id             = codigate_agent.home.id
  identity_provider_id = codigate_identity_provider.okta.id
  policy = {
    email_domains = ["example.com"]
    groups        = ["engineering"]
  }
  service_token_ids = [codigate_service_token.ci.id]
  bypass_paths      = ["/health"]
}

resource "codigate_app" "status" {
  name     = "Status page"
  hostname = "status.example.com"
  agent_id = codigate_agent.home.id
  access   = "public"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Id of the agent that reaches the origin.
- `hostname` (String) Public hostname, lowercase without a trailing dot. It must be under the workspace's app domain or a verified custom domain.
- `name` (String) Display name (at most 100 characters).

### Optional

- `access` (String) protected (sign-in through identity_provider_id and policy) or public (no sign-in; paid plans with a verified custom domain). Defaults to protected.
- `bypass_paths` (Set of String) Path prefixes served without sign-in, for example /healthz (at most 20, protected access only; leave it out for none; paid plans with a verified custom domain covering the hostname).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app serves traffic. Defaults to true.
- `identity_provider_id` (String) Identity provider users sign in with. Required together with policy for protected access; an app without one is not live yet.
- `policy` (Attributes) Who may sign in. At least one rule must allow someone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy))
- `service_token_ids` (Set of String) Service tokens that may call the app without signing in (protected access only).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) App id.

<a id="nestedatt--policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy`

Optional:

- `email_domains` (Set of String) Allowed email domains (lowercase), for example example.com.
- `emails` (Set of String) Allowed email addresses (lowercase).
- `everyone` (Boolean) Allow everyone who can sign in at the identity provider.
- `groups` (Set of String) Allowed groups from the identity provider's groups claim (OIDC only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By id or by hostname.
terraform import codigate_app.wiki app_0123456789abcdef
terraform import codigate_app.wiki wiki.example.com
```
